title: Build a Roving Tabindex Navigation Menu
description: Create a dropdown menu that uses roving tabindex and arrow key navigation.
problemStatement:
## Roving Tabindex Menu Create a simple vertical menu with three menu items (File, Edit, View) using `role="menu"` and `role="menuitem"`. The menu should: 1. Initially, only the first item has `tabindex="0"`, others have `tabindex="-1"`. 2. When user focuses any item (via mouse or keyboard), ensure only that item gets `tabindex="0"` (and others `-1`). 3. Arrow Down moves focus to the next item (wrapping from last to first). 4. Arrow Up moves focus to the previous item (wrapping). 5. Enter or Space on a menu item triggers an alert showing the item name (simulating selection). Provide the HTML, CSS (basic), and JavaScript. Use a single event listener on the menu container (event delegation) to handle keydown. Start with this markup: ```html
  • File
  • Edit
  • View
```
hints: On arrow key, find current index, increment/decrement, and focus the next element (also update tabindex).
Add a `focus` event listener on the menu (delegated) to update tabindex when any item gets focus.
expectedOutput: A working menu with proper roving tabindex and keyboard navigation.
